Real Localized Case Studies

Sample Case Studies & Insights

See how we adapt English app descriptions into natural, high-converting Japanese copy.

AI Meeting Notes App

PRODUCTIVITY APP LOCALIZATION
BEFORE: Literal Translation
「AIを搭載した会議アシスタント。すべての会議を録音し、要約して整理します。」
Original: AI-powered meeting assistant.
AFTER: Japan Launch Native Copy
「AIが会議内容を自動で整理。
面倒な議事録作成や情報共有を、もっとスムーズに。」
Japanese Copy: AIが会議内容を自動で整理。議事録作成をもっとスムーズに。

Focus on Benefits, Not Features

The original copy emphasizes technical features. Japanese users often respond better to clear outcomes than feature lists. Instead of highlighting that the app is 'AI-powered', we focused on saving time.

Japanese User Tip & Insight

Japanese App Store users typically look for practical value first. Copy that answers 'How does this help me?' feels much more trustworthy than feature-heavy descriptions.

What Changed & Key Improvements

Replaced technical wording with user benefits
Improved natural Japanese flow
Adapted tone for Japanese readers
Focused on clarity instead of direct translation
KEY TAKEAWAY

"Localization isn't about translating words. It's about making your product feel natural to Japanese users."

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

What do I need to send to get started? +

Just send your App Store, Google Play, or landing page URL. If your app isn't public yet, simply paste your English description or pitch into the form. No complicated setup or spreadsheets required!

Do you use AI translation or human copywriting? +

Both — AI speed combined with 100% human perfection. We use AI for rapid initial drafting and terminology research, and every single word is carefully rewritten, culturally adapted, and polished by a professional Japanese content writer.

Is this just a translation service? +

No. We don't do literal word-for-word translation. We provide high-converting Japanese copywriting and ASO (App Store Optimization). We optimize your titles, keywords, and benefit-driven copy so Japanese users immediately understand why your app is worth downloading.

How do I receive and publish the localized copy? +

You'll receive ready-to-use Japanese copy in a clean Google Docs and Word file. You can simply copy and paste the text directly into App Store Connect, Google Play Console, or your website.

How long does delivery take? +

App Store & Google Play Listing Packs are delivered within 2 business days. Landing Page copywriting is delivered within 2–3 business days.

What if I need revisions or adjustments? +

Free revisions are included with every order! If you want to tweak the tone, emphasize specific features, or refine keywords, we'll gladly polish the copy until you are 100% satisfied.

Refund & Revision Policy

Last Updated: August 2026

1. 1 Free Revision Included

Every delivered package includes 1 free revision round within 7 days of delivery. If you need tone adjustments, specific feature re-emphasis, or keyword tweaks, we will refine the deliverable based on your unified feedback.

2. Additional Revisions & Major Updates

Subsequent revision rounds (beyond the 1st included round) or requests made after the 7-day window are available as lightweight paid add-ons (starting from $49). We also provide ongoing support for your future major app updates.

3. Refund Policy

Due to the custom creative nature of copywriting and localization deliverables, orders cannot be refunded once drafting work has commenced. However, if a deliverable does not match the agreed scope after your included revision, we will work with you to resolve the matter fairly.
